Show where projects differ from their manifests

Usage: slipway diff [OPTIONS] [NAME... | project/NAME...]

Arguments:
  [NAME]...  The name of a project

Options:
  -l, --selector <EXPR>  Selector (label query) to filter on
  -A, --all-groups       Compare every project across all groups with its manifest
  -h, --help             Print help (see more with '--help')

Use "slipway --help" for a list of global options (applies to all commands).
